description: End-to-end proof for the leveling loop and status-effect DoT. Sets level 9 with XP just below the level-10 threshold, then a mob-kill grants XP that crosses into level 10 - a milestone level - firing the runtime progression listener (level-up message + RecalculateStats via refreshPlayerProgressionBonusesNow + milestone/perk-selection message). Then spawns test mobs and applies a BURN status effect so MotmMobRuntimeSystem's per-frame DoT application (executeDamage) can be observed.
